How it’s scored

Add conference and Serious Business points for one total out of 100.

Above 80, each additional point counts less toward the total.

Conference stats · up to 70 points

  • Real leads · first 8 worth up to 6 points, next 16 worth up to 2 more
  • 4 per deal closed, up to 47
  • 1 per $5,000 in closed deal value, up to 10
  • Side events · first 5 worth up to 3 points, next 10 worth up to 2 more
  • Talks attended · 0 points

Serious Business · up to 71 points

Each amount adds points independently. Extra pints, cigs, and party favors earn less as the tally grows. Fewer hours slept add more points. A blank field adds zero.

  • Pints · up to 20
  • Cigs · up to 14
  • Party favors · up to 15
  • Blackouts · up to 6
  • Hours slept · up to 16
